messages:
mike: Noticed a small but consistent TLS handshake error rate in ap-south and eu-central after midnight RBAC sweep. Symptoms: downstream services seeing peer cert validation failures.
mike: Example proxy log: ```2026-03-23T00:12:03Z ERROR proxy: TLS handshake failed: unwrap error: AccessDenied: Requestor not authorized to use the key projects/prod/keys/edge-keystore/cryptoKeyVersions/2 for decryption```
anya: Which RBAC change landed? was this the least-privilege keystore prune?
mike: Yes 17: PR 5191 removed legacy role bindings (keystore-reader, keystore-legacy) and converted to scoped bindings via infra-policy-gen.
devon: KMS audit?
auditbot: KMS Audit Summary: 117 UnwrapDenied events across ap-south & eu-central in last 30m for alias/edge-keystore. Caller identity: serviceAccount:proxy-worker@edge-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com -> denied.
kevin: That caller looks right. Possible cause: policy-gen emitted principal with short name `service:proxy-worker` instead of the full serviceAccount identity.
anya: Also worth checking key versioning. If an older key version is still referenced in proxy config, unwrap for V1 might be disabled by HSM rotate.
devon: Good point. Run: `gcloud kms keys versions list edge-keystore --location=global` and compare with proxy config `kubectl -n edge get cm proxy-config -o yaml`.
mike: I ran that. Config pointed to cv=2, but policy allowed only cryptoKeyVersion 3 after rotation automation. So two issues: principal mismatch in policy and deny on cv=2.
kevin: Mitigation plan: 1) add temporary allow for proxy-worker SA to decrypt on cv=2 and cv=3 in ap-south & eu-central; 2) push a proxy config update to point to cv=3; 3) revert the overly-broad RBAC prune that removed keystore-reader until we patch policy-gen.
anya: Rollout approach: canary ap-south then eu-central, monitor UnwrapDenied metric + TLS handshake rate.
ops-bot: Action: created rollback task infra/rollback-5191, canary env ap-south. Use `./infra apply --patch revert-5191 --env ap-south-canary`.
devon: After re-adding SA allow and updating config on ap-south canary, unwraps succeeded and TLS handshakes normalized. Audit shows UnwrapDenied cleared for canary.
auditbot: Post-mitigation audit: UnwrapDenied events for edge-keystore dropped from 78->0 in ap-south canary window.
mike: Next steps (short): - pause global RBAC prune rollout; - patch policy-gen to emit full serviceAccount identities; - add CI preflight that tries a KMS unwrap using a canary key and target SA for every RBAC change; - add key-version checks in deploy pipeline so config CV matches allowed versions.
kevin: Long-term: add cross-region KMS replication check + a synthetic mTLS smoke that establishes a full handshake through edge proxies (exercise KMS unwrap, cert parse, and downstream verify). Also ensure audit logs are shipped with enriched fields `principal_full` and `key_version` to make triage faster.
anya: Opening incident INC-2026-1501 with timeline, affected regions, and immediate mitigations. Assigning on-call infra and platform owners.
mike: Thanks team. Reminder: avoid wildcard removal without a staged admit gate that runs unwrap simulations.
kevin: Agreed. I'll draft an RFC for the policy-gen fixes and the pre-merge unwrap smoke tests.
ops-bot: Noted: incident INC-2026-1501 created and assigned.
